question:
**Select the most appropriate option for the given group of words.**

A set of rooms specially in a hotel for the use of one person or his family
solution:
The correct answer is '**Suite**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Suite**'.
 
• It means 'a set of rooms, especially in a hotel'. [कमरों का एक सेट, विशेष रूप से एक होटल में]
 
 
• Example: the honeymoon/penthouse suite</stro
